scope.summary: Implement a governance-owned Tailor native-surface contract checker that rejects positive legacy web requirements before activation; native registration, shared-wgpu, AccessKit, and Argus runtime proof is owned by MT-708.
acceptance_criteria: The checker scans every Tailor MT allowed path, acceptance criterion, and proof target and rejects positive React, Tauri-command, WebView, data-testid, Playwright, Vitest, rendered-PNG-to-WebView, or foreground focus-stealing requirements.
Explicit negative prohibitions and historical migration evidence are distinguished from executable positive requirements, and findings name the exact MT and JSON pointer.

The checker is a mandatory pre-activation/signed-refinement gate; MT-708 separately proves native pane/command registration, shared wgpu context, AccessKit identities/actions, Argus steering/capture, and quiet operation.
scope.risk_if_missed: Parallel native and web frontends would duplicate behavior, split testing, and preserve a known 15-fps readback bottleneck.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Governance-only pre-activation checker; MT-708 owns native runtime registration, AccessKit, and Argus proof.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: The checker is repo governance and does not ship an operator-facing product workflow.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
